title: Elevator/Tube travel outside of mallworld??
content: I had posted in r/abductions about a recurring dream I have that involves a grocery store with a special exit into a giant mall. Upon entering this mall, I start exploring. Sometimes coming across video game stores and geek/rpg stores. But at the end.lf the dream, before I waks up, I come across a... gate? Kind of like at an airport. There is a bus/plane/train you can go on, it varies randomly OR... there is an elevator you can take. This elevator is more like one of those tubes at a water park where the bottom opens underneath you and you fall. But it's weirder then that. If you're carrying a bag and the bag hits the side, it will bring you back up and restart the falling process. Once completed, I wake up. ---- Anybody else seen this elevator/gate in their mallworld dreams?
